blogs.title: When Bone Marrow Failure Isn’t Just B12 Deficiency: Red Flags for Telomere Biology Disorders
blogs.description: A deep dive into how ineffective erythropoiesis and pancytopenia can mask an underlying telomere biology disorder. We’ll review the hematologic clues (low retic count, dimorphic smear, marrow findings) that should prompt a genetic work‑up even after correcting obvious nutritional deficiencies.

blogs.title: Beyond the Mucocutaneous Triad: Recognizing ‘Silent’ Dyskeratosis Congenita in Adults
blogs.description: Discusses the expanding phenotype of telomere syndromes that lack classic DC skin, nail, and oral findings. The post will outline a systematic approach to suspecting TBDs in young adults with multisystem fibrosis, premature greying, and osteoporosis, and will provide a practical diagnostic algorithm.

blogs.title: PARN Mutations: From Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis to Multisystem Fibrosis – What Clinicians Need to Know
blogs.description: Explores the emerging spectrum of monoallelic PARN variants, focusing on their role in pulmonary and hepatic fibrosis. Includes a review of the molecular pathogenesis, recent case series, and recommendations for screening lung and liver disease in patients with PARN‑related TBDs.

blogs.title: Genetic Testing in the Era of Overlapping Fibrotic Diseases: When to Order a Telomere Panel
blogs.description: Provides guidance on choosing genetic testing strategies (clinical exome, targeted telomere panels, telomere length assays) for patients with unexplained fibrosis of the lung, liver, or bone marrow. The article highlights cost‑effectiveness, interpretation of variants of uncertain significance, and counseling considerations.

blogs.title: Management Strategies for Telomere Biology Disorders: From Supportive Care to Stem Cell Transplant
blogs.description: An evidence‑based overview of current therapeutic options for TBDs, including vitamin supplementation, androgen therapy, antifibrotic agents, and indications for hematopoietic stem cell transplantation. The post will use the presented case to illustrate decision‑making pathways and surveillance protocols.

blogs.title: The Hidden Burden of Hepatic Fibrosis in Telomere Disorders: Screening and Monitoring Recommendations
blogs.description: Focuses on liver involvement in TBDs, a frequently under‑recognized manifestation. Discusses the utility of elastography, laboratory markers, and longitudinal monitoring, and proposes a follow‑up schedule for patients with known telomere gene mutations, using this case as a teaching model.
